_comment: Stock cooked components we override, copied from the local sim install at build time and patched with a hidden that loads pill.js once. MasterPage_InGame is the in-flight root of the fullscreen mainUi view, so it only mounts in flight (Toolbar_Trigger was tried first, but it renders in the toolbar's own 1836x324 panel view). No installed mod overrides it (42 Flow owns HUD_AirTraffic/HUD_Waypoint, FS24-UI owns MenuBarPage).
